methodology.pushword_probe: Five shuffled samples of 20 documents; native values include process startup, JSON and validation.
methodology.tempest: Nine samples of 50 in-process parse calls after one warm-up; Markdown is parsed with Markdown(null), without code highlighting.
methodology.inputs: The same four deterministic workloads and the 59-case PHP differential corpus are used for every available engine.
methodology.scope: Component measurements on one development machine, not end-to-end public, admin or static-generation latency.

parse_many_pr_branch.note: This measures one parseMany call containing 20 chunks; it is not a stable package release.

notes: Comrak uses a custom formatter for the compatible Pushword subset; ten corpus gaps remain intentional and are recorded by the Rust test.
Tempest output is not folded into the compatibility score because its heading IDs, attributes and other serialization rules differ from Pushword.
The pulldown-cmark and markdown-rs values remain historical parser references from the earlier exploration; they are not part of the current PHP probe.
